description: This is a unit test source code for the OrderService in a C# e-commerce application, testing order creation from basket items, handling missing basket, and empty basket scenarios.

classes.name: OrderServiceTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing OrderService functionalities such as creating orders from basket items.

methods.name: CreatesOrderFromBasketItems
methods.description: Test case for successfully creating an order from basket items.

methods.name: ThrowsWhenBasketMissing

methods.name: ThrowsWhenBasketEmpty
methods.description: Test case to verify that an exception is thrown if attempting to create an order with an empty basket.
